test_ui: Warn when event handler for UI takes too much time. Since event handler for UI is run in the event loop, if test run some heavy load in event handler, it would block the event loop and the UI would be irresponsible (especially the "Mark failed" button would stop working). Warn about this case so that developer of pytests can be aware of the potential issue. BUG=b:64963909 TEST=make test TEST=manually on DUT.
